heroLead: A curious mind with a passion for engineering, creativity, good food and building meaningful digital communities. I bring ideas to life through skill, service and imagination.
about: I'm Star Jennie — an electrical engineer with a creative side and a people-first approach. My interests and professional skills span engineering, food services, online community management and visual design.
Whether I'm solving a technical challenge, creating a memorable food experience or helping a digital community thrive, I enjoy bringing care, precision and fresh ideas to everything I do.

services.title: Electrical Engineering
services.description: Technical thinking, practical problem-solving and an engineering mindset focused on safe, thoughtful solutions.

services.title: Catering
services.description: Food preparation and catering with attention to flavour, presentation and a welcoming experience.

services.title: Web Community Management
services.description: Supporting online communities through communication, engagement and organized digital interaction.
